title: crumbkit/self-runs-list/v1
description: Each run in the usage log, grouped by session and in order within each session, and a summary of the runs read.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

caller.description: The coding agent's id, such as claude-code, person or unknown.

CodeRuns.description: The runs that tolerated one code.

code.description: The code that the failed runs printed.

runs.description: The runs that tolerated the code. A run counts each code once.

RunRow.description: One run in the usage log.

at.description:
When the run ended, in RFC 3339 to the second in UTC, such as
`2026-10-11T11:56:40Z`.

caller.description: The coding agent's id, such as claude-code, person or unknown.

code.description:
The code of the run's failure or refusal, such as
`shelf::books::not_found`, or null when the run recorded none.

command.description:
The command path below the tool's name, such as `books show`, or the
tool's name for its root command.

exit.description: The run's exit code, or null when the run ended before it exited.

flags.description: The names of the flags that the caller typed, never their values.

help.description: Whether the run printed a help page.

ms.description: The run's wall time in milliseconds.

out_bytes.description:
The bytes that the run wrote to standard output, or null when the
run did not reach `finish`.

parent.description:
The span id of the run's caller, as 16 lowercase hex digits, or null
when the run started a new trace.

run.description:
The run's own span id, as 16 lowercase hex digits, which its child
runs name as their parent.

session.description:
The run's session, numbered from 1 in the order of each session's
first run in the listing's window.

step.description: The run's place in its session, from 1.

trace.description:
The id of the W3C trace that the run belongs to, as 32 lowercase hex
digits.

truncated.description: Whether a listing or stream cut the run's output short.

UsageSummary.description:
The summary of the runs that `self usage` read. The text output prints
it as one line above the table, such as `1,284 runs in 23 sessions since
30 Sep: claude-code 1,201, person 83.`

callers.description: The runs of each caller, the most first.

runs.description: The runs that the report read.

sessions.description: The sessions that the runs came from.

since.description: The day in UTC on which the report starts, such as 2026-09-30.

skipped.description:
The records that the report left out, because they named a command,
flag, code, caller or trace id that the tool does not write.

tolerated.description:
The codes of the failures that runs reported and carried on past,
with the runs that tolerated each, the most first, at most 10.
